proposals.evidence: DEDR 3821 lists Tamil paccai, Malayalam pacca, Kannada pasir/pasur/pacce (modern hasiru with regular p > h), Kodagu pacce, Tulu pacca and Parji pay green. The selected simple colour forms belong to this family; explicitly Telugu-influenced compounds and divergent Toda responses are excluded.
